seedExceptions.consequence: 9–12 V development limit on every revision (O-15); pins 16–19 reserved, so the codec difference is invisible to the contract; the fitted revision is recorded at first bring-up (R-2)

seedExceptions.exception: No Electrosmith document states the Seed MCU's package in words. DS-S3 p. 1 names only "STM32H750"; DS120 and DS105 name no part number. seedExceptions.consequence: mcu.seed.part stays STM32H750IB without a package letter, and the ST check runs every contract function on both packages (STM32H750IBKx and STM32H750IBTx); the ports and AF numbers agree on both (spec §5.2)

pins.notes: The Daisy bootloader may run a USB host here (§5.4). Our bootloader must enumerate on pins 36/37 (O-11, §6.4). ST ROM bootloader uses PB14 as USART1_TX, a push-pull output with pull-up (AN2606 Rev 70 Table 135; facts.md §3). S1 Task 10 fix round (crossings.md §7.3): the idle-high TX looks like a low-speed attach, so a host on the pedal's USB-C resets the port by driving SE0 (≥ 10 ms, ≥ 50 ms from a root port, retried) through 28–49.5 Ω against PB14, which then carries more than 20 mA (DS12110 Rev 10 Table 61 guarantees VOH ≥ VDD − 1.3 V at 20 mA), past the 20 mA IIO absolute maximum (Table 22). Ruling R-14 (final): the pedal fits U_USBSW, TI TS3USB221RSER (C130085), on pins 36/37 between this pin and the USB-C/USBLC6-2; it is open unless firmware drives pin 11 (USB_EN_N) low, so it is open through reset, the ST ROM bootloader and with the module unpowered (VCC from 3V3_D; IOFF ±2 µA at VCC = 0, SCDS220M §5.5). Protection class isolation-buffer-ioff, part role usb-isolation-switch (R-14 replaces R-12's usb2-attach-protocol; the attach argument still holds with the switch closed). Second safeguard: unplug the pedal's USB-C before ROM DFU entry (spec §6.4). Bring-up checks full-speed enumeration and the eye with the switch's ≤ 6 Ω in the path (crossings.md §7.4)
